verdict.rationale: Semgrep is a security scanning platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at docs.semgrep.dev/mcp, but the pack gives no detail on setup, exposed tools, transport or agent clients, so the depth of the capability is unproven. Missing for 10: details of exposed MCP tools and capabilities, setup and connection instructions for agents, supported clients and transport, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.semgrep.dev/mcp
